acceptance: Auth contexts are explicitly source- and client-bound; wrong audience, expiry and revoked grant are rejected.

positive.fixture: grants bound to caller, exact source, exact audience and scopes; a table of 9 wrong-use cases; RS256, ES256 and EdDSA tokens verify

negative.fixture: expired and revoked grants, audience, origin, scheme, prefix and suffix confusions, none/HS256/crit/duplicate-member token attacks, tampered audit chain, free-text audit records refused

security_and_source_permissions: A denial is generic to the caller; the audit log records the real reason from a closed vocabulary.
performance_memory_storage: No measurable cost; checks are map lookups and string compares.
known_limitations: Hardened by VSF-B14-T08 to T12: compare-and-swap store, identity flag, provider digest
